parameters.help_en: The ID of the association between the ECR and the VPC or transit router
parameters.name: association_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disassociate the ECR from the transit router or VPC. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关是否是删除与TR或VPC的关联关系。取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: delete_attachment

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run to check the request without modifying the service resource.
false (default): Sends a regular request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique parameter value from your client. The client token supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the request ID as the client token. Each request ID is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。
